hardware.variant: One assembled kit with operator-reported CoreBoard V1.2.

inputs.name: ESP_MOSAICO_SC101IOT RAM kernel FIT with an added ALLPON init record

scenario: Append zero-parameter ALLPON command 0x23 to the panel init sequence (DT record 23 00 00 00). Boot the optional SC101IOT RAM kernel, read CO5300 status registers, run the SC101IOT identity probe, and inspect the display without starting LVGL.
expected: After initialization, the panel shows solid white independently of GRAM contents, and the fitted sensor ID is read.
observed: The SPI driver completed panel initialization including ALLPON without reporting an error. CO5300 ID, power, format and brightness status reads returned 0xff without reported bus errors. The display remained completely black. LVGL was not started. The SC101IOT identity-only driver attached at SCCB address 0x68 and read PID 0xda4a.
limits: One assembled V1.2 sample; this RAM trial did not write NOR. The kernel FIT and static RAM root hashes identify the tested inputs.

The ALLPON transfer completion and status reads do not prove that the panel accepted the command or establish physical SPI timing, panel power or the cause of the black display. No claim of a working physical SPI path is made.
The sensor check establishes identity only. DVP frame capture is not implemented, so it does not establish an EmberBSD camera preview or operation of other modules.
This trial did not test touch calibration, audio, Wi-Fi or LVGL rendering.
The UART log and device identifiers remain private.
